We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts: The defendant added sodium nitrite (亚硝酸钠) to food (驴肉) as a preservative or color fixative. This is a food safety violation. The list includes "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (production and sale of food not meeting safety standards), "生产、销售伪劣产品", "生产、销售假药", "生产、销售有毒、有害食品". Sodium nitrite is a food additive, but exceeding safe limits is considered illegal addition of a harmful substance. The appropriate crime likely "生产、销售有毒、有害食品". However, is sodium nitrite considered a toxic harmful food? It is a food additive but can be harmful if overused. The list also includes "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". That seems more generic for unsafe food. The example earlier: "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" used for case where a seller sold health product containing sildenafil (a drug) - that was considered toxic/harmful food. Here, adding sodium nitrite beyond allowed limit is a violation of food safety standards. So likely "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Let's see if there is a specific crime for adding prohibited additives: In Chinese criminal law, there is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (Article 173). Also "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" (Article 173 also includes). Actually Article 173: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品" and "生产、销售有毒、有害食品". Both are separate? The list includes both. Which one fits? Sodium nitrite is a permitted additive but limited. Overuse may be considered "不符合安全标准". So choose "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also could be "生产、销售有毒、有害食品" if considered toxic. But safer is the first.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>
